title: Publish delivers to the consumer with matching body, message-id and producer-supplied trace-id
asA: developer publishing a domain event through the producer facade
iWant: a message published through publish() to reach the registered consumer with body byte-equal and headers including a stable message-id and my producer-supplied trace-id
soThat: downstream traceability across the enqueue-to-process boundary is a byte-for-byte property, not a hopeful convention

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a message published through the facade with a producer-supplied trace-id in headers, when the consumer subscribes on the same queue, then the received body equals the published body byte-for-byte and the received headers include the stable message-id assigned by the platform on send plus the producer-supplied trace-id, verified across all five messages in the publish-to-delivery probe.
acceptanceCriteria.given: 5 messages published through the facade with producer-supplied trace-ids
acceptanceCriteria.when: the consumer processes the queue batch
acceptanceCriteria.then: all 5 messages are received with body byte-equal, message-id present and stable per message across the delivery, and the producer-supplied trace-id present on the message headers

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a successful consumer return on a message, when the facade dispatches the batch, then a messageAcked event fires on the injected sink with messageId and queueName matching the received message; the message is not redelivered on subsequent batches.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a message delivered to the registered consumer
acceptanceCriteria.then: a messageAcked event fires with messageId and queueName; the message is not redelivered
